properties.name: Bear Butte (Mato Paha)
properties.description: Sacred mountain of the Lakota and Cheyenne. Where Crazy Horse received visions and Sweet Medicine brought the sacred arrows.
properties.modernStatus: State park, active sacred site, prayer cloths visible

properties.name: Cahokia Mounds
properties.description: Largest pre-Columbian settlement north of Mexico. Monks Mound is the largest earthwork in the Americas. Wooden Stonehenge (Woodhenge) tracked solstices.

properties.name: Devils Tower (Bear Lodge)
properties.description: Massive rock formation sacred to multiple Native American nations. Lakota name means 'Bear Lodge.' Striations are claw marks from a giant bear.
properties.modernStatus: National Monument, voluntary climbing ban in June

properties.name: Mesa Verde Cliff Dwellings
properties.description: Ancestral Puebloan cliff dwellings built into canyon walls. Kivas (circular ceremonial chambers) connected communities to the spirit world.

properties.name: Shiprock (Tsé Bitʼaʼí)
properties.description: Volcanic rock 483m high, sacred to Navajo. Called 'Winged Rock' — legend says the Navajo once lived on top, carried there by a great bird.
